newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks rebound, test resistance.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks rebound, test resistance.

text.p: Mexican stocks rebounded from an early low to test resistance as some foreign buyers stepped into the market to pick up cheap stocks, traders said.
"Some foreigners are buying, and it had to rally after consolidating for several sessions," said a trader from the Arka brokerage house.
The blue chip IPC index was up 34.61 points, or 1.05 percent, at 3,327.84.
Traders said the bourse had broken a pyschological barrier at 3,300 points, and was testing resistance at 3,326.
